activity.notes: Vasyl Vyshyvanyi (Archduke Wilhelm of Austria) supported the Ukrainian national movement and in 1919 served as a colonel in the War Ministry of the Ukrainian People's Republic. The user-supplied Kingdom of Galicia and Lodomeria is not used because he did not rule that Habsburg crown land.

sources.title: Encyclopedia of Ukraine — Vyshyvany, Vasyl
sources.citation_text: The Encyclopedia of Ukraine states that in 1919 Vyshyvanyi served as a colonel in the War Ministry of the Ukrainian National Republic.

sources.title: 1914-1918 Online — Wilhelm, Archduke of Austria
sources.citation_text: The scholarly encyclopedia describes Wilhelm Habsburg's pro-Ukrainian political orientation and his command of Ukrainian troops during the late Habsburg period.
